name: CREATE parking_sessions
func:
msg.topic = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parking_sessions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  plate TEXT NOT NULL,
  entry_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
  exit_time DATETIME,
  payment_time DATETIME,
  exit_valid_until DATETIME,
  amount_due REAL DEFAULT 0,
  amount_paid REAL DEFAULT 0
);'; return msg;

name: CREATE parking_spots
func:
msg.topic = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS parking_spots (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  floor INTEGER NOT NULL,
  spot_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  sensor_id TEXT,
  occupied INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  last_updated DATETIME DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime'))
);'; return msg;

name: CREATE user_admins
func:
msg.topic = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_admins (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  rfid_uid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  role TEXT DEFAULT 'admin',
  active INTEGER DEFAULT 1
);'; return msg;

name: CREATE event_types
CREATE rfid_admin_releases
func:
msg.topic = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rfid_admin_releases (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  admin_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  rfid_uid TEXT NOT NULL,
  parking_session_id INTEGER,
  release_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  FOREIGN KEY (admin_id) REFERENCES user_admins(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (parking_session_id) REFERENCES parking_sessions(id)
);'; return msg;

name: CREATE event_logs
func:
msg.topic = 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_logs (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now','localtime')),
  eventtype TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT,
  message TEXT,
  parking_session_id INTEGER,
  FOREIGN KEY (eventtype) REFERENCES event_types(name),
  FOREIGN KEY (parking_session_id) REFERENCES parking_sessions(id)
);'; return msg;
